propositions: ChatGPT sessions in connector-limited environments (no local clone, no Gerrit access, no mounted tracker worktree) lack guidance on what operations remain safe and when native ticket creation is impossible.

Native ticket creation is impossible precisely when the tracker-worktree dimension fails AND (network/remote access fails OR native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable); this decision rule must be stated explicitly.

Fallback ticket payloads must conform to export.schema.json's actual required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status, description, parent_id) with ticket_id as an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on import, enabling idempotent re-import without hand-transcription.

rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path (NDJSON, not raw events; fresh local ids/HLC timestamps; idempotent by source_id); in --dry-run mode, missing ticket_id/ticket_type records are silently skipped with no warning, no counter increment, and are detectable only via would_create + skipped != total record count.

Guidance must prohibit hand-authored event-file mutations and GitHub Contents-API writes to the tickets branch, require search-before-create when the live tracker is accessible, and state that GitHub is a read-only mirror for code (Gerrit is the code-review path).

A lightweight test must verify AGENTS.md linkage, no GitHub-Issues-as-substitute claims, no Contents-API-as-sanctioned guidance, rebar import as the only exceptional path, and payload schema conformance against the actual export.schema.json required array.
